title: One-Pot Tuscan White Bean Soup with Turkey Sausage and Kale
hook: One pot, 6 bowls, freezes for a month: Tuscan white bean soup in 40 minutes
benefit: High in fiber and protein from the beans and turkey, with iron and vitamin K from the kale
ingredients: 12 oz lean Italian turkey sausage (or chicken sausage), casings removed
1 tsp dried rosemary (or 1 tbsp fresh, chopped)
2 cans (15 oz each) cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 bunch lacinato kale (about 5 cups), stems removed, chopped
Salt and black pepper to taste
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high. Add the sausage and cook 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, rosemary, thyme and red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.

Mash 1 cup of the beans with a fork (this thickens the broth with no cream). Add them with the whole beans, the tomatoes with their juice, the broth and the Parmesan rind. Bring to a boil, then simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in the kale and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until tender and bright green. Fish out the rind.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the lemon juice. Taste and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with grated Parmesan. Keeps 4 days in the fridge and freezes well for up to a month.
vo_steps: Brown the turkey sausage in olive oil, breaking it up as it cooks.
Soften the onion, carrots and celery, then stir in garlic, rosemary and thyme.
Mash a cup of the beans, then add everything with the tomatoes and broth, and simmer twelve minutes.
Stir in the kale and cook three more minutes.
Off the heat, finish with lemon, salt and pepper.
Serve with Parmesan, and freeze the rest for busy nights.
